author: reek
body: The Mandelbrot set, as a [Device] compute kernel. One GPU thread per pixel maps its (px, py) to a point c in the complex plane, iterates z = z*z + c counting steps until |z| escapes, and writes a colour from the escape count. The iteration is a tail-recursive helper -- the WGSL plug lowers it to a structured `loop`.

author: reek
body: Inside the set is black; escaped points get a smooth cycling palette that drifts with frame.
